description.value:
Duration constant

When you Strike as part of The Answer, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll, and that attack roll ignores any penalty from the frightened or sickened condition. Strikes that are not part of The Answer gain nothing from this feat.

cinderfall.incomplete: Two independent blockers: (1) The Answer is a homebrew reaction with no built-in engine hook -- no roll option automatically flags "this specific attack/action is this specific triggered reaction," so a bonus or exemption scoped only to that one-off use has no predicate to hang on without either an unscoped always-on toggle (which overstates the card) or a linked/expiring Effect grant, a mechanism this corpus's feat cards don't have. (2) Ignoring a condition's numeric penalty for one specific roll has no rule-element hook -- real Vambrace of Gorum (reduce frightened by 1 as a reaction) already ships rules: [], and ignoring the penalty outright is a stronger version of the same unencoded effect class.
